senses.gloss: m. (מָחַק 2) strike, an instrument for levelling a measure of grain &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:9">B. Mets. VII, 9</cite> <he>המ׳ שיש וכ׳</he> the strike which has a (secret) receptacle for a piece of metal (to increase its pressure fraudulently); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:13:1">Koh. R. to IX, 13</cite> <he>המחק</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 89b:6">B. Bath. 89ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 618:1">Yalk. Lev. 618</cite> <he>אין עושין המ׳ של דלעת וכ׳</he> the strike must not be made of gourd, because it is too light &c.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 618:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אין עושין את המ׳ צדו וכ׳</he> (Yalk. l. c. <cite ref="R00100"><he>צדה</he></cite> fem.) you must not make the strike thick on one side and thin on the other; a. e.—Pl. <he>מְחוֹקִים</he>. Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ bot.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 21:9">Lev. R. s. 21</cite> <he>מְחוֹקיהֶן של כסף</he> the strikes sent with the measures were of silver.
